instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot from a slightly high angle. Inside a judo dojo, the young woman in the blue judo gi (R1) grapples on the yellow mat with the young man in the white judo gi (R2). The young woman (R1) is on top, pinning the young man (R2) by wrapping her legs around his torso while looking down at him. The young man (R2) lies on his back, looking upward with a neutral expression. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting that casts soft shadows on the yellow and blue mats.
